A-1.says: in-run standing flags (not sure / ask) the provoking answers

A-2.says: in-run standing supports (consistent / known) the control answers

A-3.says: in-run == read-after on every answered layer run (event = turn_end = assessAnswer = agent.assessment(), one event per answer); off fires no event

A-4.says: model-facing bytes: every case serves the same first request under off and layer

A-5.says: answer bytes: every answered layer run returns the model's final text, byte for byte

A-6.says: correct answers: mean facts-in-answer on the controls does not fall

A-7.says: needless hedges and asks on the controls do not rise
A-7.threshold: hedges: layer ≤ off + 0.1; asks: layer ≤ off + 0.1

A-8.says: overhead: input tokens per model call, and model calls per run
